findings.title: ADR-0005 summary table default contradicts Decision section channel choice
findings.detail: The Decision section (line 237) states output is DM'd to '#ifleet-proposals' channel. The summary table row 5 'Default if no answer' says 'Reuse #ifleet (1504120127791042631)'. These directly contradict each other — the Decision section has already chosen #ifleet-proposals, so the safe default should align with that choice, not override it with #ifleet.
findings.fix_sketch: Update summary table row 5 'Default if no answer' from 'Reuse #ifleet (1504120127791042631)' to 'New #ifleet-proposals channel (per ADR-0005 Decision section)' to make the table consistent with the body.
findings.fix_summary: Updated summary table row 5 'Default if no answer' from 'Reuse #ifleet (1504120127791042631)' to 'New #ifleet-proposals channel (per ADR-0005 Decision section)' to align with the body text.

findings.title: index.json nightly_audits lists 20260717T040000Z.json which does not exist on disk
findings.detail: The nightly_audits array in .audits/index.json contains '20260717T040000Z.json' but no such file exists in .audits/. Every other filename in the list matches a real file. This phantom entry will cause tooling that iterates nightly_audits and reads each file to throw a file-not-found error.
findings.fix_sketch: Remove '20260717T040000Z.json' from the nightly_audits array in .audits/index.json.
findings.fix_summary: Removed phantom '20260717T040000Z.json' entry from nightly_audits array in .audits/index.json.

findings.title: plan.md finding schema shows fix_sketch but omits fix_summary field used when closing
findings.detail: The finding object schema in plan.md (§Phase 1) shows 'fix_sketch' as the planning field but does not document 'fix_summary', which is the field written to index.json when a finding is fixed/closed (as seen in self-heal-pipeline.md closed.json schema and every fixed finding in index.json). A reader of plan.md alone would not know fix_summary exists.
findings.fix_sketch: Add 'fix_summary' to the finding schema example in plan.md with a note that it is null for open findings and populated when closing.
findings.fix_summary: Added 'fix_summary' field (null for open, populated string when fixed) to finding object schema in plan.md §Phase 1.

findings.title: lane-list.sh uses STALE_AFTER while lane-prune-stale.sh uses STALE_AFTER_SEC for related timeouts
findings.detail: In lane-scheduler-spec.md: lane-list.sh configures staleness via STALE_AFTER (no unit suffix, described as '>10 min') while lane-prune-stale.sh uses STALE_AFTER_SEC (explicit seconds, default 3600). These appear to be separate env vars for different thresholds (10 min warning vs 60 min reap), but the naming inconsistency makes it hard to tell if they share a config surface or are independent.
findings.fix_sketch: Clarify in the table that STALE_AFTER and STALE_AFTER_SEC are intentionally separate env vars: STALE_AFTER controls the list.sh warning threshold (minutes or seconds — clarify units), STALE_AFTER_SEC controls the prune threshold (seconds). Add units to STALE_AFTER description.
findings.fix_summary: Clarified in lane-scheduler-spec.md that STALE_AFTER (seconds, default 600 = 10 min) and STALE_AFTER_SEC (seconds, default 3600 = 60 min) are intentionally separate thresholds: STALE_AFTER for warning in lane-list.sh, STALE_AFTER_SEC for reaping in lane-prune-stale.sh.
